A [[Pantoran]] '''male''' was present in [[Cid's Parlor]] in [[19 BBY]]<ref name="Date note">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' places the events of [[The Bad Batch Season 1|''The Bad Batch'' Season 1]] in [[19 BBY]].</ref>, where he played against [[Omega]] in a game of [[dejarik]], watched by a small crowd. During the game, the Pantoran used his [[Kintan strider]] to knock out Omega's [[K'lor'slug]]. However, his opponent used her [[monnok]] to take out his Kintan strider and [[Mantellian Savrip]], winning the match. After his defeat, the Pantoran walked away from the gaming table with dismay. The Pantoran had blue eyes, unlike most members of his species whose eyes were yellow.
